raw_policy_excerpt:
If you are a Steam user and have a security issue to report regarding your personal Steam account, please visit our support site https://help.steampowered.com/.

Please read the scope, bounty, and severity information carefully before submission.

# Scope
This program covers the Steam platform and current games developed and published by Valve.

The Steam components in scope are:
* Steam Client, Steam Client Service, and the SteamCmd command-line utility for Windows, Mac and Linux
* Steamworks SDK
* Steam mobile apps on iOS and Android
* Steam Servers
* Websites as noted on the Scope section of the program. Subdomains of listed websites are not in scope unless mentioned.

For games developed and published by Valve, if the game is in scope, we accept reports against:
* Game client and server binaries.
* First-party, unmodified, game servers.
* Game coordinators.

Game bugs, glitches and gameplay exploits are not in scope.

## Exclusions
Out-of-scope for all Valve offerings:
* Vulnerabilities reported by use of automated tools/scanners, without accompanying validation / POC.
* User enumeration without any further impact.
* Clickjacking without a well-defined security/privacy risk.
* Attacks that require social engineering/phishing.
* Attacks that require physical access to the user's device.
* Open redirects or linkfilter bypasses that cannot be leveraged to programmatically exfiltrate sensitive information.
* Self XSS, or XSS that only affects out-of-date browsers.
* Denial of Service Attacks.

Additionally out-of-scope for game components:
* Reports against Source Engine tools, e.g. Hammer, Source Filmmaker.
* Reports that require the user to open crafted game content: demo files, BSPs, etc not delivered as part of the exploit.

Ineligible for Bounty (game reports):
* Reports that require crafted content (maps, sounds, mods, etc.) delivered via the Steam Workshop.
* Techniques not specifically mentioned above that cause a game-client crash without demonstrated RCE behavior.
* Techniques that require information from the target machine in order to function.

## Special Note for Valve Websites
Many Valve websites use a cookie called 'sessionid.' This is used only as an anti CSRF token and is not used for user authentication. Please do not report attacks resulting in leaking the value of this cookie as account takeover vulnerabilities.

## RCE Requirements
Actual RCE must be demonstrated (e.g. launch Calculator). The payload must be delivered over the network.

## Responsible Disclosure
* Only interact with accounts you own or with explicit permission of the account holder.
* Make a good faith effort to avoid privacy violations, destruction of data, and interruption or degradation of our service.

## The Fine Print
You must comply with all applicable laws in connection with your participation in this program. You are also responsible for any applicable taxes associated with any reward you receive.
